description: AMP: log a new entry. Required: type + msg (one sentence). Optional: file, line, tags, detail. Call it without being asked when: the user is stuck ('!!', 'not working', 'same error', 'retry' → type attempt: what was tried and how it failed); the user asks you to remember something (save the fact in your own words); a decision is made (type decision: X over Y because Z); you learn something non-obvious (type gotcha, with file/line). These apply in any language the user writes in. Don't log what can be re-derived from the code. Use 'detail' for a rich multi-paragraph body (repro steps, code, full reasoning, or a session snapshot) — it's stored in a sidecar and loaded on demand, so it never bloats the always-on memory index.

detail.description: Optional rich body (Tier-2). Stored in the consolidated details store; NOT injected into rule files. Put the long-form context here; keep 'msg' to one summary sentence.

name: amp_write
